message.content: Shenzhou 8 was an **unmanned test flight**. It carried no astronauts aboard; its purpose was to test the spacecraft’s docking system and other systems before later crewed missions.

According to known info: Shenzhou 8 was a test flight of the Chinese space program, launched in 2008. It had two crew members: Yang Liwei (the first Chinese astronaut) and Liu Boming? Wait, Shenzhou 8 was a test flight with no crew? Actually Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight? Let's recall: Shenzhou 7 had the first Chinese spacewalk. Shenzhou 8 was a test flight of the spacecraft's docking system, but I think it was also unmanned? Let me check memory: Shenzhou 8 was launched on 29 September 2008, and it was an unmanned test flight of the spacecraft's docking system. It had no crew. So the answer: It was an unmanned test flight; there were no astronauts aboard. But the question might be expecting "Shenzhou 8 had no crew; it was an unmanned test flight."
